The '''Gantho system''' was in [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It included the planet [[Gantho]]. [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] illegally stripped the resources of the system's planets.

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], the New Republic launched a full-scale investigation into allegations that Loronar Corporation had committed abuses in the system.<ref name="NEGWT:xx">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'', p. xx</ref>
